announcements.text: Everyone, please rinse all beakers, flasks, and other vessels thoroughly after use. Facilities staff have reported finding used glassware with visible broth, bacterial residue, and other materials still inside.They are here to support our team, and leaving contaminated or visibly soiled vessels for them to handle is neither appropriate nor respectful. Please make sure all items are properly rinsed before they are left for cleaning.Thank you for your cooperation!
announcements.html:
Everyone, please rinse all beakers, flasks, and other vessels thoroughly after use. Facilities staff have reported finding used glassware with visible broth, bacterial residue, and other materials still inside.

They are here to support our team, and leaving contaminated or visibly soiled vessels for them to handle is neither appropriate nor respectful. Please make sure all items are properly rinsed before they are left for cleaning.

Thank you for your cooperation!
